title_zh: 減重粽竟然沒有味道？！表情全崩了😂
title_en: Trying a 'Diet Zongzi' with No Flavor… Their Faces Say It All 😂
caption_zh: 第一次吃減重粽，結果沒有任何調味，忘記沾糖直接入口，表情全部崩掉哈哈哈😂 你們吃過嗎？
caption_en: They tried a 'diet zongzi' for the first time — no seasoning, forgot to dip in sugar, and their faces completely gave them away 😂 Have you ever tried one?

title_zh: 香菜花生冰心粽！裡面真的有香菜😱
title_en: Cilantro INSIDE the zongzi?! Their reactions say it all 😱
caption_zh: 香菜花生冰心粽挑戰🌿粽子裡竟然真的藏著香菜，表情全說了哈哈哈！你敢吃嗎？👇
caption_en: Cilantro peanut ice-heart zongzi challenge 🌿 They thought it was just decoration… nope, it's ALL the way inside 😂 Would you dare try it?

title_zh: 女團成員排練無聊偷跳舞😂
title_en: Girl Group Member Secretly Dances During Rehearsal 😂
caption_zh: 排練太無聊就自己找事做？女團成員親口爆料：只要有鏡子，所有人都忍不住！😂 #一席 #女團日常
caption_en: Too bored during rehearsal so she just… started dancing? Girl group members can't resist any mirror they walk past 😂 #girlgroup #behindthescenes

title_zh: 把浣熊當貓帶回家？還是自信唱錯歌詞？
title_en: Would You Bring a Raccoon Home Thinking It's a Cat?
caption_zh: 問卷題目太荒唐😂 誰會把浣熊當貓帶回家？結果本人說「就算當成貓我也不會帶，因為我嚴重貓過敏」🤣 下一題：誰會自信滿滿地唱錯歌詞？
caption_en: The quiz question was wild 😂 'Who would bring a raccoon home thinking it's a cat?' — only to get 'I wouldn't even if I thought it was a cat, I'm severely allergic!' 🤣 Next up: who sings lyrics wrong with full confidence?

title_zh: 粽子不想出來😂邀請找妮吃朋友！
title_en: The Zongzi Doesn't Want to Come Out 😂 Idol Eats Her 'Friend'
caption_zh: 打開粽子葉，粽子硬是不肯出來🤣主持人直接邀請找妮來吃她的「朋友」，這梗也太衝擊了吧！#端午節快樂
caption_en: The zongzi refused to come out of its leaf 🤣 so the host invited the member literally named 'Zhaoni' to eat her 'friend' — the most chaotic Dragon Boat Festival moment ever.

title_en: Accidentally Raised TWO Hands While Scoring 😂
caption_zh: 評分環節直接出包🤣 明明說好舉一隻手，結果不小心生出兩隻手，自己也笑翻了！#粽子試吃 #直播名場面
caption_en: Rating snacks and accidentally raised BOTH hands 🤣 Even she couldn't keep a straight face after that blunder!

title_zh: 吵架假哭獲勝？成員互相爆料！
title_en: Who Fake Cries to Win Arguments? Members Call Each Other Out!
caption_zh: 「誰會在吵架時假哭來獲得優勢？」這題直接讓成員們互相爆料，笑到不行🤣 #直播精華
caption_en: 'Who fake cries during arguments to get the upper hand?' — the members immediately start calling each other out 😂 #LivestreamHighlight

title_zh: 粽子裡藏整隻麻油雞腿？！
title_en: There's a Whole Chicken Leg Inside This Zongzi?!
caption_zh: 剝開粽葉才發現裡面藏了整隻麻油雞腿🍗「天哪還要啃骨頭！」這粽子也太狂了吧😂 #端午節 #粽子
caption_en: They unwrapped a giant zongzi only to find a WHOLE sesame-oil chicken leg inside 🍗😱 "We still have to gnaw the bone?!" Most chaotic dumpling ever 😂

title_zh: 嚴格評審只給一根手指頭😂金華火腿粽評分時刻
title_en: Harsh Judge Gives Only One Finger 😂 Zongzi Rating Moment
caption_zh: 拿超小一口、給超低分，這位評審也太嚴格了吧😂 金華火腿粽你敢挑戰嗎？
caption_en: Took the tiniest bite and still gave the harshest score 😂 Would you try a Jinhua ham zongzi?

title_zh: 以為很難切結果誤會它了😂｜粽子開箱試吃
title_en: We Totally Misjudged This Food 😂 | Live Taste Test
caption_zh: 一開始以為皮超難切，結果根本很好切😂 米飯看起來超南部風！開動～ 你們喜歡哪種米的粽子？👇
caption_en: Thought it was impossible to cut… turns out we totally misjudged it 😂 The rice looks so Southern-style and the smell is amazing. Which style do you prefer? 👇

title_zh: 告白氣球得獎啦！接下來玩遊戲🎈
caption_zh: 粽子開箱結束，告白氣球抽獎倒數5秒揭曉得獎者，接著宣布下一個環節——考驗默契的團隊遊戲，米粉跟麋鹿恭喜中獎！🎉
caption_en: Zongzi unboxing done! The giveaway countdown hits zero, winners are revealed, and the girls tease a fun team chemistry game up next 🎈🎉
